svg.title: Channel layer — plywood 9 mm
svg.desc: Cut. OD 220 (R110) — it stops there, and the 6 mm gap out to the white ring at R118 is the outer light channel. The C channel R79-93 goes right through. BOTH STRIPS STAND ON EDGE against a wall: the C strip inside the R93 wall facing in, the ring strip on the R110 outer edge facing out. 9 mm suits 5 mm tape; for 10 mm tape cut this layer 12 mm.
